sections.title: 3. External Interface Requirements
sections.text_preview: This section of the SRS describes the interface requirements for the system. Requirements for user, hardware, software, and communication interfaces are defined.

sections.title: 3.1 User Interfaces
sections.text_preview: This subsection of the SRS defines the UI requirements for the VDS and QDR.

sections.title: 3.1.1 Volatile Data Stream
sections.text_preview: The UI for the VDS must comply with the requirements of the application that executes the MTConnect Agent as defined by the standard documentation [1].

sections.title: 3.1.2 Query-able Data Repository

sections.title: 3.2 Hardware Interfaces
sections.text_preview: All server-side components must execute on server-class computers. All client-side components must execute on workstation-class and personal-class computers.

sections.title: 3.3 Software Interfaces

sections.text_preview:

sections.title: 3.4 Communication Interfaces
sections.text_preview: The communication architecture must follow the client-server model. Communication between the client and server should utilize a REST-compliant web service and must be served over HTTP Secure (HTTPS).

sections.title: 4. System Features
sections.text_preview: This section of the SRS describes the requirements for the system's features. Specifically, requirements for component functionality, data curation, and software system administration are defined.

sections.title: 4.1 Component Functional Requirements
sections.text_preview: This subsection of the SRS describes the functional requirements for the VDS and QDR components of the software system.

sections.title: 4.1.1 Volatile Data Stream
sections.text_preview: VDS/001 The VDS component of the software system must comply with all enumerated requirements for an application to execute an MTConnect Agent in the standard documentation [1].

sections.title: 4.1.2 Query-able Data Repository

sections.title: 4.2 Data Curation
sections.text_preview: This subsection of the SRS describes the requirements for data curation within the software system.

sections.title: 4.2.1 Description and Priority
sections.text_preview: The software system must provide a function to store and manage data in a database according to a data-structure template (e.g., schema, ontology).

sections.title: 4.2.2 Functional Requirements
sections.text_preview:
Curate/001 The software system must provide a RESTful API for curating data in the database.

Curate/002 The software system must provide the data curator with the ability to add data to the database
